Actually Li is not producing, but he receives equipment and raw materials from others, then via logistics gives to his mother Zhu, who without license produces drugs at home, and then through logistics gives back to Li, from which they profit. The description: "未经批准生产药品" - not necessarily controlled substances? Could be "非法生产、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存假药" or "非法生产、买卖、运输、储存药品" (maybe "非法生产、买卖、运输、储存假药" is a crime). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "非法生产、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存假药罪" (Article 141). Also there is "非法生产、买卖、运输、储存毒品罪". Here it's about drug (药品) not necessarily controlled. Likely "非法生产、买卖、运输、储存假药罪". The mother produced drugs without license, likely "非法生产药品" which is a crime under Article 141. The son facilitated logistics, so also guilty of same.
